propositions: Pass-2 verification blocks are already persisted correctly in code-review findings (97.5% of 3,669 recorded REVIEW_RESULT events carry verification blocks with {binary, severity_attributes}), contradicting the original premise.
No alerting or warning mechanism exists when an expected verification block is absent from an LLM-tier decided finding after Pass-2 ran (verification_recorded signal is unimplemented).
The detection predicate must scope to LLM-tier findings excluding indeterminate/no-verification cases to avoid standing false alarms on routine runs with DET-tier or legitimately unverified findings.
The sidecar payload preserves all fields via field-spread (_with_norm_ids {**f, ...}) rather than selection, so verification blocks survive build_payload round-trip without regression risk.

A metrics key verification_recorded must be added to coverage["metrics"] in _attach_code_review_metrics, set False with WARNING when verify_requests > 0 and expected LLM findings lack verification blocks, True otherwise.
